name: Will You Sign?
source:
You are elected president of a country and must choose whether or not to sign the documents that may or may not be beneficial and ensure your approval in power during your three-year term.

Sign the laws that you deem necessary for the country's growth based on the parameters of the economy, health, society and security of the population. But beware! The laws are not quite what you expect. Be careful what you decide, because your decisions can have side effects...

[Translated from [url=https://cheesaki.itch.io/will-you-sign]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你當選了一個國家的總統，必須決定是否簽署擺在面前的文件。這些文件可能有利於國家，也可能適得其反，還會影響你在三年任期內的支持度。

根據經濟、醫療、社會和民眾安全等指標，簽署你認為對國家發展必不可少的法律。但要小心！這些法律並不完全是你想像的那樣。謹慎做出決定，因為你的選擇可能帶來意想不到的後果……

[譯自[url=https://cheesaki.itch.io/will-you-sign]Itch.io[/url]]
